description: Emblem Row Slam (final, 0.8 s) — bold MY TURN slams in from 2x with a gold shockwave; the logo divider snaps open and the six element emblems pop out along it from the centre outward, hold, then everything fades out smoothly

overlay.format: WebM, VP9 video with alpha channel (yuva420p, alpha_mode=1), straight/non-premultiplied alpha, no audio track

anchor.placement: draw the 1920x1080 canvas unscaled at 1080p (scale 1:1 with the stage) with its centre on the battlefield centre; in the reference layout that is (954,510), the centre gem of the board divider, i.e. canvas top-left at (-6,-30). Plain stage centre (960,540) also works.

dim.note: no dim: the battlefield stays fully visible; overlay is pointer-events:none and gone after 800 ms

endState: overlay fades out smoothly from 500 ms and is fully transparent by the last frame; remove it when the video ends

sfx.note: start together with the overlay (t=0); its tail fades with the visual fade-out (from 500 ms)

sources.fxElements: Kling 3.0 pro clip mt_A from the v1 batch (reused, no new generation), keyed from black to additive light; element-colour glows, rings and sparks rendered in code
sources.lettering: rendered in code in the logo typeface, bold: Google Sans Flex weight 880 (v2 used 550) (SIL OFL, the open release of the Product Sans / Google Sans design the wordmark uses), per-glyph width tuned to the wordmark; gold grain texture sampled from logo_wordmark_stand.png, its measured gradient, dark-red outline and inner rim
sources.sound: re-timed native audio of v1 Kling clip mt_A, layered with synthesized sub thump / body hit / low swell / rumble; loudness-normalised; no sonilo/mirelo

fadeOut.curve: cosine ease-in-out (opacity = (0.5+0.5cos(pi*u))^1.35); every layer (lettering, emblems, glows, particles) fades together; fully transparent on the last frame

changesFromV2: duration 500 -> 800 ms (hold extended; entrance timing unchanged); divider moved 8 px lower for the taller bold letters; sound re-fitted to 800 ms with a low bloom and fading tail
lettering much bolder: Google Sans Flex wght 880 (v2: 550), stem/cap 0.168 -> ~0.28, tracking 0.02 -> 0.03; same logo-sampled gold texture, outline and bevel
natural fade-out 500-783 ms (cosine ease) replacing the late, steep fade
